name: Molten Descent
description: Convert the meteor to fire damage and apply extra burn.

name: Shattering Impact
description: Shockwave: +1 knockback and 25% more collision damage.

name: Astral Infusion
description: Charge the stone with starlight. Damage becomes holy.

name: Unleash Charge
description: Deal 2 extra damage per Cosmic Charge on the caster.

name: Gravity Collapse
description: Stun 0.05 turn per Gravity stack on the target, and consume those stacks.

name: Cryo-Comet
description: Ice meteor: frost damage and 1 Freeze stack (vanilla Freeze).

name: Thunderstrike Meteors
description: Electrically charged impact: electricity damage and stun.

name: Voidfall
description: Void-cold stone. Damage becomes frost and the impact frostbites.

name: Orbital Velocity
description: For every tile between you and the target, add 0-2 damage.

name: Event Tide
description: Apply 2 extra Gravity stacks on hit.

name: Gravitational Shear
description: Apply 0.05 turns of Vulnerable per Gravity stack, then consume those stacks.

name: Cosmic Inflation
description: Capstone spacetime stretch. +2 area and +2 range.

name: Charge Spark
description: One extra Cosmic Charge (or whatever stack the spell already applies).

name: Gravity Tick
description: The stone tugs. Apply 1 Gravity even on a plain meteor.

name: Star Reach
description: Drop the stone from a little farther out. +1 range.

name: Ember
description: A coal of star-heat. +1 burn, without converting the payload.

name: Quick Fall
description: The meteor arrives sooner. -0.1 cast time.

name: Short Arc
description: For every tile between you and the target, add 0-1 damage.
